info.title: YapSpace API
info.description: Public API for YapSpace, the shared discussion layer for web pages.

get.summary: Liveness: 200 while the process is serving, 503 once shutdown has started.
Readiness: 200 when the database answers within 2 s and the process is not draining, else 503.

200.description: The database answers and the process is not draining

503.description: Not ready: the database is unreachable or shutdown has started
